messages:
marta: quick note from review of PR 515: console observability docs look much better, but found a few followups before merge: 1) Go SDK tracehook example missing a tiny bit (SetMetric vs SetTag naming), 2) cost/latency field names inconsistent across examples, 3) one interactive widget iframe falls back to a 404 in staging. can we triage?
aj: thanks. i can normalize the field names. prefer `token_cost_usd` and `latency_ms` as standard. i'll add a docs-lint rule and a short migration snippet explaining the rename.
kevin: i'll take the Go snippet. what's the minimal shape you want? we have JS+Python already in other pages. keep it focused on creating a hook, attaching context, and emitting two tags.
marta: exact shape: create hook, attach trace id, set token_cost_usd (float) and latency_ms (int). one code block, <10 lines. note about units is helpful.
kevin: draft here: ```go
import "github.com/redwood/trace"

hook := trace.NewHook("console")
hook.AttachContext(map[string]string{"trace_id": traceID})
hook.SetTag("token_cost_usd", 0.0041)
hook.SetTag("latency_ms", 78)
```
aj: perfect. i'll match the SetTag name in the Go SDK reference too. i'll also add a linter rule to catch legacy names like `cost_tokens_usd` and `token_cost`.
docs-bot: PR 515 opened by marta  reviewers: @aj @kevin. CI: docs-link-check running.
tara: about the iframe: staging preview shows the interactive widget iframe returning 404 at /widgets/interactive-cost-demo. i can add a graceful fallback (static png + caption) if infra can't fix route fast.
infra-bot: docs-link-check result: /widgets/interactive-cost-demo -> 404. created infra ticket 339 (assigned to @dave). route was removed in router-cleanup PR 804; possible mismatch.
kevin: i'll add the Go snippet commit now and include a tiny note pointing to the SDK reference. keep it tiny so it doesn't bloat the page.
aj: adding docs-lint rule now (regex replace + unit tests). will include a line in the migration guide and a short changelog entry saying `token_cost_usd` is the canonical key.
tara: adding fallback: if iframe 404, render /assets/interactive-cost-demo-static.png and a one-liner `Interactive demo temporarily unavailable; see static preview or run locally.` will slip that into the PR as a guard.
marta: plan: kevin adds Go snippet + link, aj lands linter + changelog note, tara adds fallback static image. merge contingent on infra#339 or fallback staying. target: merge by end of day. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: infra#339 acknowledged by dave-infra. ETA 6h for investigation (router cleanup rollback or redirect).
docs-bot: docs-link-check (after fallback added) shows docs page OK (200), iframe still 404 but static fallback present. PR marked blocked on infra#339 for full interactive experience.
marta: great. i'll update PR description with infra ticket and mark changelog entry. thanks all, will re-request review once linter CI passes. /end of thread
